description: This file defines constants, macros, data structures, and external references related to ARM64 MMU configuration in Zephyr OS, including memory types, attributes, and region management.

classes.name: arm_mmu_region
classes.description: Structure representing a memory region with base addresses, size, name, and attributes.

classes.name: arm_mmu_config
classes.description: Structure holding the number of regions and a pointer to an array of regions for MMU configuration.

classes.name: arm_mmu_ptables
classes.description: Structure containing translation table base address and TTBR0 register value.

methods.name: MMU_REGION_ENTRY
methods.description: Macro to initialize an arm_mmu_region structure with specified parameters.

methods.name: MMU_REGION_FLAT_ENTRY
methods.description: Macro to create a flat memory region entry with the same base physical and virtual address.

methods.name: MMU_REGION_DT_FLAT_ENTRY
methods.description: Macro to generate a region entry from device tree node ID and attributes.

methods.name: MMU_REGION_DT_COMPAT_FOREACH_FLAT_ENTRY
methods.description: Macro to generate multiple region entries for device tree nodes matching a specific compatible string.
